paragraphs: In Yoma 78b, Rabbah bar bar Chana said: “I saw Rabbi Elazar of Nineveh go out in a sandal of bast.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Yoma 78b fully writes Rabbi Elazar of Nineveh, supporting that expansion of ר״א. The sandal’s material is שאם, here rendered “bast”; the translation does not establish a botanical identification.

The whole Davidson Yoma 78b paragraph fully names Rabbah bar bar Chana and Rabbi Elazar of Nineveh, supporting the local expansions. Hyman’s supplied sandal wording and the rendering “bast” are retained without a botanical identification or additional legal material.
